name: koloda-gallery-snapshots
purpose: Immutable images in native galleries and optional article-scoped ratings.

endpoints.wiki_images: Normalize Special:Redirect/file static filenames to public /images/ URLs; reject separators/control bytes. The redirect has CORP same-origin.
endpoints.wordpress: same-origin wp-admin/admin-ajax.php; private catalog/import and public state/vote

authentication.vote: published gallery membership, nonce, origin and signed random identity/account pseudonym

retry.redirects: at most 2 allowed-host image redirects; 8 seconds each
retry.backoff: explicit retry; shared client handles 429 Retry-After and stale data

idempotency: Connection-scoped MariaDB lease and article/library/object/variant snapshot key; unique vote index supports atomic update/removal.
rate_limit: One image/request, 40 selections, 100 rows/page, 200 page cap; one vote/second per voter/article.

observability.fields: public IDs and safe outcome/cache age; no identities

degradation: Retain selection/partial attachments on failure; local galleries and votes survive provider outages.
privacy: Guest functional cookie only on voting; no IP/fingerprint/outbound account data. Account export/erasure; one-year identity anonymization preserves historical averages.
rollback: Revert exact SHA through pipeline; preserve media, native shortcodes and vote table. No destructive uninstall.
